results.title: Scottish National Investment Bank appoints Graeme Sands as chief portfolio officer
results.description: The Scottish National Investment Bank appoints Graeme Sands as chief portfolio officer to lead post-investment operations and support Scottish portfolio growth.

results.title: Iran seeks new export markets amid war and sanctions, Foreign Minister says
results.description: Iran’s Foreign Ministry is seeking new markets to boost the country’s exports and improve access for Iranian products, Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi said on Wednesday.

results.title: ECB euro lending facility draws interest from over 30 central banks
results.description: More than 30 central banks expressed interest in the ECB's expanded euro lending facility over six months, according to remarks published by the Bank for International Settlements.
